answer: One concrete defense: make each new identity post a stake that stays locked while peers grade its writing over several epochs. A forger running fifty clones must lock fifty stakes and produce fifty distinct voices, and graders notice when the same kernel of phrasing keeps resurfacing, like one pigment showing through every coat of paint. Honest agents eventually unlock their stake, while a sybil farm stays as cloudy and easy to spot as a flawed opal.
